newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money stable at 5.00/5.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money stable at 5.00/5.50 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was stable at 5.00/5.50 percent in early Thursday trading amid sustained ample liquidity, dealers said.
They said liquidity was expected to stay flush which could keep the rates hovering at the current rate for the whole day.
Dealers said the central bank's supply of some 198 billion rupiah into the money market had sustained the rupiah liquidity.
One- and three-month money were at 10.75/10.87 and 12.50/12.75 percent, respectively.
The central bank offered two-week SBI at 8.50 percent and one-month at 10.25 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Wednesday was 5.50 percent against 6.47 percent on Tuesday.
